gloss: the streets, the public, the world at large

definitions.gloss: the streets, the public, the world at large
definitions.explanation: The general public sphere or everyday world. Used to refer to what is being talked about, what is popular, or what is happening among ordinary people.

examples.japanese: {巷|ちまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: It is the talk of the town.

examples.japanese: {巷|ちまた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{交|か}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Various rumors are flying around in the streets.

examples.japanese: {巷|ちまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられ→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧、さらに⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A health method popular among the public was also featured on TV, drawing even more attention.

notes:
USAGE:
{巷|ちまた} is a somewhat literary or journalistic word referring to the general public sphere. It is often used to introduce what people are talking about or what is trending. Common patterns include {巷|ちまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (in the public sphere, among people) and {巷|ちまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (the talk of the town). While it literally means streets or crossroads, it is rarely used in a purely geographical sense in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巷|ちまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: the talk of the town
- {巷|ちまた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{溢|あふ}れる→溢れる：04250_afureru⟧: to be all over the streets
- {巷|ちまた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: the voice of the people
- {巷|ちまた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{流行|りゅうこう}る: to be popular among people
